title: Core: merge shapes and break apart group operations
description: Implement two operations in packages/core/src/engine/mutations.ts: (1) mergeShapes(doc, sceneIndex, layerIndex, frameIndex, shapeIds[]) -> FlashDocument: combine multiple ShapeObjects into one by concatenating their paths (Flash 8's Modify > Combine Objects > Union, simplified to path concatenation). (2) breakApart(doc, sceneIndex, layerIndex, frameIndex, objectId) -> FlashDocument: split a group/symbol-instance into its constituent shapes, placing them directly on the frame. For symbol instances, extract the shapes from the symbol's first keyframe. Add 8 unit tests.
